agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/engine/statement_splitter.py: the condition resetting `_seen_begin` in `StatementSplitter.process()` was missing a `not`, causing it to clear the flag on the very BEGIN token that set it instead of on subsequent tokens. This broke detection of standalone `BEGIN;` and `BEGIN TRANSACTION[;]` as transaction statements (both raw and reindent-formatted), which are the three reported failing behaviors. Added the missing negation so `_seen_begin` is only cleared when a token other than BEGIN is encountered, restoring correct splitting while leaving BEGIN...END block grouping and other control-structure (FOR/WHILE/LOOP/IF/CASE/DECLARE) handling unaffected. Verified via direct python -c checks of sqlparse.split/format for 'BEGIN;', 'BEGIN TRANSACTION;', 'BEGIN TRANSACTION; SELECT 1;', formatted 'begin transaction;', and a real 'BEGIN SELECT 1; END;' block (still correctly kept as one statement).
